d: How you structure your server determines maintainability, scalability, and testability. Start with monoliths, understand MVC, learn when microservices make sense. The 12-factor app methodology guides production-ready design.

p: Server Architecture is how your backend components are structured. Monoliths put everything in one codebase. Microservices break domains into independent services. Both have distinct trade-offs.
1. Monolith: Easy to deploy, single DB, tightly coupled.
2. Microservices: Independent deployments, independent DBs, hard to orchestrate.
3. Start with a Modular Monolith before splitting into services.

// In a monolithic architecture, modules call functions directly.
const invoice = billingService.generate(user.id);

// In microservices, they communicate over network (HTTP/gRPC)
const res = await fetch('http://billing-service/api/generate');

Monolith:                   Microservices:
[ Auth + Billing + UI ]     [Auth]  [Billing]  [UI]
         |                     |        |       |
     [Database]             [DB1]     [DB2]   [Cache]
